title: The assignments export lists one row per customer per person with Side
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have three active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A, sales rep B and sales rep C.
  • Use customer A, whose one Sales Representative is sales rep A.
  • Use customer B, with Service Labor set to sales rep A and Service Parts set to sales rep B.
  • Use customer C, whose one Sales Representative is sales rep C and whose "Sales Representative - Part Sales" is also sales rep C.
  • Make sure the customer names sort A to Z as customer A, customer B, customer C, and that sales rep A's name sorts before sales rep B's.
  • Open Reports > Export Reports (in the Reports left sidebar, under Accounting) in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide, so the "Export Report" dialog is open.
custom_steps:
1. Pick "Sales Representative Assignments" in the Report Name list.
  2. Click Export.
  3. Open the downloaded file.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "Sales Representative Assignments" is selected.

Step 2:

  • A file named sales-representative-assignments.csv downloads.

Step 3:

  • The column after "Representative is active?" is named "Side".
  • Customer A has one row: sales rep A, Side "Parts and Service".
  • Customer B has two rows: sales rep A "Service Labor" and sales rep B "Service Parts".
  • Customer C has one row: sales rep C, Side "Parts and Service, Part Sales".
  • The rows run by customer name, A to Z (customer A, then customer B, then customer C).
  • Within customer B, sales rep A's row comes before sales rep B's.

The Sales By Representative spec, version 28 (12 Oct 2026, S15-R1, S15-R4, S15-R5 and S15-R9), names the export, its heading ("Rep is active?") and its Side values differently. Chris Ward ruled on 19 Oct 2026 for the PRD (answers 17 and 18, quoted below); this case follows PRD version 11.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R23: “The "Sales Representative Assignments" export, file sales-representative-assignments.csv, lists one row per customer per person, with a column, Side, after "Representative is active?". The one representative of a customer that is not split reads "Parts and Service". A split customer lists "Service Labor" and "Service Parts". "Part Sales" is listed for the person in an added Part Sales field, split or not. A person in more than one field of one customer gets one row listing them in window order, separated by ", ", for example "Parts and Service, Part Sales".”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 17: “17. (a) as the feature spec: "Sales Representative Assignments", column "Representative is active?", Side after it; file name sales-representative-assignments.csv.”
  • Chris Ward's answer 18: “18. (a) as the feature spec.”

From: Tech plan "Splitting Sales Representatives — Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 14 Oct 2026, planned against PRD version 8; uploaded 19 Oct 2026 and again, byte-identical, 22 Oct 2026), read in full 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan, Assignments export (section 4.1, row order): “ORDER BY LOWER(co.name), LOWER(sales_rep_name), co.id, csr.user_id”
  • Tech plan, Assignments export (section 4.1, one row per person): “Then fold in PHP into one row per (customer id, user id).”
